implementation.name: original-v3-vol3-asynchronous-freshness-pipeline
implementation.scope: Original panels retained: synchronous four-member reference, asynchronous behavior versions, and one-record admission path. A and C sampled at v0, B at v1; A is checked at v1, B at v3, and C at v4. Declared maximum lag = 2 updates. This is a per-record check, not complete group eligibility.
